mentions.name: ChatFrom.io
mentions.description: AI chatbot provider where users upload a knowledge base and the service uses advanced RAG with hybrid search and reranking to answer questions. It connects to Stripe, Shopify, and other tools, and works on Telegram, Slack, and more. Free to start.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on ChatFrom.io . It is an AI chatbot provider. You upload your knowledge base, and it uses advanced RAG with hybrid search and reranking to find answers when someone asks a question. It connects to Stripe, Shopify, and other tools, and works on Telegram, Slack, and more. Free to start.
